title: Design System: Biomédica · Clínica del Niño

display.purpose: The one H1 per screen; 28px on phone, 36px at lg, balanced wrap.

headline.purpose: Section heads, sheet and card titles; 20px to 24px at lg.

title.purpose: List-row primary text and header user name.

body.purpose: Lead paragraphs and all input text (16px so phones never zoom).

meta.purpose: Row secondary lines, header subtitle, hint blocks.

label.purpose: Buttons, pill-tabs and field labels; 12px for badges and kv labels.

shadows.name: bar-lift
shadows.purpose: Fixed save bar on Registrar, casting upward.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and press on buttons, pills, rows and inputs.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations forced to 1ms

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The capture/save pill. One per screen; 56px large variant for the main CTA.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>Registrar mantenimiento</button>

components.name: Ink Button

components.name: Ink Strip
components.description: The audit/export band: ink plane, 32px corners, white plus outline pill pair.
components.html:
Auditoría y habilitación anual

Descargue el reporte consolidado anual o mensual.
components.css: .ds-strip { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; border-radius: 32px; padding: 24px; font-family: Montserrat, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 380px; } .ds-strip h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-strip p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-strip-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; } .ds-strip-solid, .ds-strip-line { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-strip-solid { background: #fff; color: #0f172a; border: none; } .ds-strip-solid:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-strip-line { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); } .ds-strip-line:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-strip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Phone nav: ink pill on the current side slot, blue capture pill in the center.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); align-items: center; height: 72px; max-width: 420px; padding: 0 8px; background: #fff; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-family: Montserrat, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: none; color: #64748b; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #1e293b; } .ds-nav-ind { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-nav-item.is-on { color: #0f172a; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-item.is-on .ds-nav-ind { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-capture { justify-self: center; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: #1d4ed8; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(29,78,216,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-capture:hover { background: #1e40af; } .ds-nav-capture:active { background: #1e3a8a; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card with Rows
components.description: Hairline card, 24px corners, tappable rows with a status pill.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Montserrat, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 380px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; padding: 20px 20px 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #0f172a; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 14px 20px; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9; background: #fff; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-row:active { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-num { width: 40px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; } .ds-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-main b { display: block; font-size: 15px; color: #0f172a; } .ds-main small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: #64748b; } .ds-pill { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #047857; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
A field logbook carried in one gloved hand. The world borrows a commerce design language (confident medium-weight type, full pill controls, large soft-cornered panels on a white canvas, a dual-CTA pairing) and renders it in the clinic app's own palette: slate ink, one action blue, and three status colors that mean exactly one thing each. Density is relaxed on the phone (48px minimum targets, one column, a sticky bar under the thumb) and opens into a two-column grid on the laptop without changing a single component.

The system is flat. Depth comes from tonal surfaces (white canvas, slate-100 soft panels, slate-900 ink strip) and from hairlines, never from gradients or stacked shadows. Shadows exist only on things that float above the page: the bottom bar, its capture pill, and dialogs.

It refuses the category default of hospital admin software: dense tables, uppercase section bars, gradient headers, and tiny icon-only controls.
keyCharacteristics: One blue for one job: capturing and saving work.
Ink (slate-900) carries structure: headings, active tabs, secondary pills, the export strip.
Everything tappable is a pill at least 44px tall; primary actions are 48 to 56px.
Three surface tones (white, soft slate, ink) and nothing else.
Status is a solid colored pill, readable at arm's length.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue fills only the capture/save action. Every other emphasis uses ink. If a screen has two blue pills, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Emerald, amber and rose describe equipment and sync state only. They are never decoration, never category colors, never chart accents.

rules.name: The Weight Means Role Rule
rules.body: 500 names, 700 acts, 400 reads. Never bold a heading; never set a button in medium.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, tabs, section heads and badges are sentence case at normal tracking. The system has no uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The Only-What-Floats Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the scroll." Anything in the page flow is flat.

dos: Do give every tappable control at least 44px of height; primary actions 48px, the screen's capture CTA 56px.
Do keep Action Blue for capture and save; use Ink pills and pill-tabs for every other emphasis.
Do pair a primary pill with an outline or ghost pill beneath it when a screen offers a second path.
Do put a sheet's or form's actions in a sticky bottom bar on the phone.
Do set form inputs at 16px and keep pinch-zoom enabled.
Do separate surfaces with tone (white, Soft Surface, Ink) and Hairline borders.
Do respect reduced motion: transitions and the sheet rise collapse to 1ms.
donts: Don't add shadows to cards or panels in the page flow; shadows are for floating bars and dialogs.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels, kickers or section bars.
Don't use emerald, amber or rose for anything but status.
Don't square off buttons or round off inputs; pills act, 8px fields take input.
Don't fall back to dense admin tables on the phone; lists are tappable rows with a status pill.
